title: Sunday Hours at the Downtown Library
text: Some city council members argue that the downtown library should extend its hours to include Sunday openings, citing rising weekend foot traffic downtown and requests from working families who can't visit on weekdays. Others argue that Sunday hours would strain an already tight budget and that usage data doesn't yet justify the cost.
